research_question: Can the public credit-migration contract and one answer-free Quant-H0 trajectory uniquely support a reusable harness mutation before mandatory review?

setup.trusted_selection_reference: The fresh Quant-H0 prescreen aggregate 106/107 result selected the task for this separately frozen lineage but was not proposal, Reviewer, or Worker input.

evidence_use.local_profile_interpretation: The Evolver-local artifact-schema-vs-contract profile covered eight authorized public artifacts. It was not a selected, component, or Worker probe and caused no downstream execution.

proposal.admission_reason: Evolver recorded ABSTAIN; candidate writes remained locked.

public_semantic_boundary.public_contract_observation: The contract defines cohort/default-rate denominators over non-default starting ratings and requires an absorbing Default row in the 8x8 transition matrix, but it does not define whether summary.total_transitions includes the absorbing Default-row counts.
supported_interpretations: summary.total_transitions may count all pooled 8x8 cells, including 21 absorbing Default-row observations
summary.total_transitions may instead be intended to count only non-default starting cohorts
public_semantic_boundary.proposal_consequence: The public 21-count difference is real but does not uniquely identify a contract violation or reusable correction. Converting 22956, 22935, or 21 into a candidate constant, expected value, threshold, or routing rule would be unsupported.
public_semantic_boundary.trusted_headroom_boundary: The separate trusted 106/107 prescreen shows aggregate headroom only. Its co-occurrence with this public ambiguity does not identify the failed property or establish causality.

candidate_leakage_audit.scope: The unchanged Quant-H0 candidate tree plus the empty diff and empty Worker-visible claim surface.
candidate_leakage_audit.interpretation: The Evolver-only abstention record discussed the public count ambiguity, but no count, score, property, checker predicate, or expected value entered a candidate or Worker-visible claim.

retained_conclusion: The public-only Stage-A proposal made a calibrated ABSTAIN and froze at proposal. It used a local public-artifact profile to recognize that the observed count difference is not semantically identifiable under the public contract, then left Quant-H0 unchanged and created no candidate mutation, Worker-visible claim, or State Card.

claim_boundary.supported: One public-only proposal-stage ABSTAIN, exact evidence reads and citations, public semantic ambiguity, unchanged parent, zero downstream dispatch, exact proposal accounting, healthy monitored execution, exact-ID cleanup, and zero residue.
claim_boundary.not_supported: A candidate, candidate admission or quality, Reviewer verdict, Worker uptake, official property diagnosis, benchmark gain, repeatability, protection, stable reuse, promotion, or main-experiment readiness.
claim_boundary.interpretation: This is calibrated insufficiency: the Evolver declined to turn a numerically salient but publicly underdetermined difference into a reusable rule.
